release_approval.reason: Numeric release thresholds must be calibrated against the frozen identity baseline and the independent official TemplateFlow transform before a neuroatlas-built candidate is evaluated.

software_provenance.development_smoke: Record the observed package version and immutable Git RemoteSha for niflowr and neurotransform; moving GitHub main is allowed only for non-production smoke evidence.
software_provenance.release: Candidate provenance must record immutable source commits for niflowr and neurotransform. A moving development reference alone is not release evidence.

panels: source and target native orthogonal views
visual_qa.interpretation: Qualitative review evidence; it never replaces numerical, direction, or deformation gates.

evidence.landmarks: A reviewed, stratified physical-coordinate landmark file is required before approval.

failure_behavior: qualification and release assembly must fail closed while release_approval.approved is false or thresholds is null
